snippet.title: HypnoFish Inc. | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4836500/HypnoFish_Inc/

HypnoFish Inc. is a first-person incremental game about working for the world's largest fishing corporation. Hypnotize fish, sell them, purchase upgrades, and uncover the mystery of this fishy business and why divers keep going missing.
